title: Restore explicit starter provisioning for local-engine builds
goal: Restore the documented local starter-model installation path in local-engine builds, including real tokenizer admission, while keeping slim protocol builds fail-closed before any download.

reuse.searched: Inspected the existing starter provisioning implementation, feature declarations, model selection, and the release inference gate; the downloader, license admission, digest checks, transactional writes, and commercial plug-host execution path already exist.
reuse.reason: The path had an unconditional local-engine guard and tokenizer validators that always returned false. The fix restores the feature gate and adds one bounded structural tokenizer validator shared by provisioning and selection, without adding a second downloader or runtime engine.
